sections.heading: 6sense: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and Enterprise and upper mid-market ABM teams that prioritize in-market accounts with predictive intent holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: SI + Credits + Predictive, SI + Credits, SI + Predictive.

sections.heading: Who 6sense is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose 6sense when enterprise predictive intent and ABM account prioritization are the primary jobs and you can run a custom-quote evaluation..

Avoid if: Compare Demandbase for competing ABM orchestration, ZoomInfo for deeper enterprise contact databases, Apollo for self-serve data+engagement, and Clay for modern multi-provider enrichment workflows..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Demandbase on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: 6sense price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
